allow_instructions: This is a Nava Studios npm-workspaces monorepo with many Next.js apps on ports 3000-3025.
Allow npm workspace commands (npm run dev -w <app>, npm install, npm run build, npm run lint) without asking.
Allow next, prettier, and tsc via npx without asking when working inside apps/ or packages/.
Allow routine monorepo navigation and inspection across apps/website, apps/*, and packages/* without asking.
block_instructions: Always ask before changing root package.json workspaces or moving apps between folders.
Always ask before database migrations or schema changes in easycook and snugglefox.
Always ask before publishing, deploying, or pushing to any remote.
